incident_summary.caveat: The traces do not store exception text, so the breaker explanation is an inference from latency signatures.
incident_summary.incident_description: One gateway incident across two windows (14:42-14:47 and 22:30-22:42 UTC), amplified by the client-side circuit breaker in projects/p06_passk/run.py line 385: CircuitBreaker(failure_threshold=5, cooldown_seconds=30) opening after ~67s gateway timeouts. R6 lost every run, R4 lost its final 95 trials.
